"""Close recorded phase owners and count fresh training/quality work separately."""

from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from v175_postprocess import REPO, ROOT, context, read, ref, source, write_once

plan, post = context()
training = read(ROOT / "train-result-v1.json")
quality = read(ROOT / "scores-v1.json")
audited = read(ROOT / "training-audit-v1.json")
owners = [read(ROOT / f"{phase}-launch-v1.json")["owner"] for phase in ["train", "review"]]
failed_owner = read(plan["prior_worker_import_rejection"]["path"])["owner"]
baseline_owner = read(post["V161_current_metrics"]["path"])["owner"]
for owner in owners + [failed_owner, baseline_owner]:
    try:
        process = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
        assert process.create_time() != owner["created"] or process.status() in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE, psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        pass
assert read(ROOT / "native-viewing-completion-v1.json")["native_figures"] == 60
assert audited["updates"] == training["updates"] == 8100
assert audited["actual_final_Adam_step"] == training["total_optimizer_updates"] == 9000
assert quality["counts"] == plan["expected_quality_counts"]
assert quality["exact_V169_replays"] == 1644 and quality["ADC_outputs_exact_V169"] == 144
assert read(ROOT / "quality-audit-v1.json")["saved_native_RGB_checked"] == 72
assert read(ROOT / "offset-audit-v1.json")["arrays"] == 30
files = list((Path(plan["external"]) / "native").glob("*.npy"))
offsets = list((Path(plan["external"]) / "offsets").glob("*.npy"))
prefix = list((Path(plan["external"]) / "training-prefix").glob("*"))
assert len(files) == 144 and sum(p.stat().st_size for p in files) == 430196736
assert len(offsets) == 30 and sum(p.stat().st_size for p in offsets) == 102780672
assert len(prefix) == 14 and sum(p.stat().st_size for p in prefix) == audited["saved_prefix_bytes"]
assert training["counts"] == dict(wrapper=8100, frozen=8100, network=8100, sampler=40500)
assert training["parent_counts"] == dict(parent=8075, DINO=8075)
assert training["new_fresh_noise_batches"] == 8073 and training["retained_cached_noisy_batches"] == 27
assert training["training_images"] == 32400 and training["skipped_ADC_batches"] == 900
permitted = read(plan["clean_sensor_preflight"]["path"])["rows"]
expected_Poisson = 9 * sum(3 if r["paired"] else 1 for r in permitted if r["noisy"] and r["fresh_noise_eligible"])
assert training["sensor_Poisson_calls"] == expected_Poisson and training["sensor_Gaussian_calls"] == 8073
assert training["frozen_weights_unchanged"] and training["RNG_unchanged"]
write_once(ROOT / "execution-completion-v1.json", dict(status="completed-fresh-noise-training-quality-and-native-viewing-recorded-owners-terminal",
    CUDA_phase_owners=owners, preserved_pre_CUDA_import_failure_owner=failed_owner, old_array_reducer_owner=baseline_owner,
    new_training_rows=9000, initial_V172_rows=1000, actual_training_optimizer_updates=8100, initial_V172_optimizer_updates=900,
    total_optimizer_updates_including_V172=9000, training_ADC_skips=900, training_images=32400, total_training_images_including_V172=36000,
    unique_scene_calibration_target_batches=1000, training_wrapper_calls=8100, training_frozen_component_calls=8100,
    training_new_matching_calls=8100, training_nested_sampler_calls=40500, training_fresh_sensor_batches=8073,
    retained_cached_noisy_batches=27, new_full_parent_training_calls=8073, new_full_DINO_training_calls=8073,
    cached_parent_runtime_replays=2, total_new_full_parent_CUDA_calls=8075, total_new_DINO_CUDA_calls=8075,
    total_new_full_parent_CUDA_images=32300, total_new_DINO_CUDA_images=32300,
    sensor_Poisson_calls=expected_Poisson, sensor_Gaussian_calls=8073,
    quality_wrapper_calls=1644, quality_frozen_component_calls=1644, quality_new_matching_calls=1500,
    quality_nested_sampler_calls=7500, quality_images=1644, exact_V169_replays=1644, ADC_outputs_exact_V169=144,
    new_matching_admission_CUDA_calls=0, new_matching_admission_CPU_calls=0, discarded_optimizer_updates=0,
    total_new_candidate_matching_CUDA_calls=9600, total_new_matching_CUDA_calls=9600, total_new_matching_CPU_calls=0,
    total_new_candidate_matching_CUDA_images=33900, total_frozen_component_CUDA_calls=9744, total_frozen_component_CUDA_images=34044,
    preserved_worker_import_failures_before_CUDA=1, preserved_CPU_preparation_rejections=2, corrected_v2_scientific_worker_failures=0,
    repeated_successful_scientific_prefix_calls=0, repeated_scientific_prefix_calls=0,
    new_scene_geometry_camera_renders=0, new_original_dataz_reads=0,
    old_V161_array_only_cases=822, old_V161_new_neural_forwards=0,
    native_cases=36, saved_native_RGB=72, saved_native_residuals=72, saved_arrays=144, saved_array_bytes=430196736,
    saved_offset_arrays=30, saved_offset_array_bytes=102780672, saved_training_prefix_batches=7, saved_training_prefix_arrays=14,
    saved_training_prefix_bytes=audited["saved_prefix_bytes"], native_figures=60, native_triplets=12,
    relevant_tests=54, CPU_tests=54, CUDA_stream_guard_tests=0, new_CPU_test_cases=18,
    trainable_parameters=2088906, trainable_tensors=141, final_Adam_states=141, actual_final_Adam_step=9000,
    frozen_parameters=124909, frozen_tensors=47, prior_neural_sources_unchanged=96,
    peak_training_CUDA_allocated_bytes=training["peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes"], peak_quality_CUDA_allocated_bytes=quality["peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes"],
    inherited_matching_admission=plan["inherited_matching_admission"], source=source(__file__),
